backend: Node CPU only; browser/GPU/FPS are separate and not measured here

budget.comparison: The manifest budgets the whole integrated tick; this probe isolates the local policy cost on the real fixture and does not certify the integrated budget.

memory.countersScope: Ownership counters only: the four policies are pure and the053/054 latches are caller-held, so no actor, opportunity, manoeuvre or episode map is retained by a module.
